test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who was the first transgender to be honoured with Padma Shri?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narthaki Natraj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

**Narthaki Natraj:**

 
• She was **born in** the Tamil Nadu **village of Anuppanadi**, which is close to Madurai.
 
• She is the **first transgender person to be honoured with the Padma Shri Award.**
 
• She is also honoured with the **SNA Puraskar **and Tamil Nadu's state award, **"Kalaimamani”.**

**Padma Shri:**

 
• The Padma Shri, which is also written **Padma Shree, is the fourth-highest civilian honor** granted by the Indian Republic, ranking behind the Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, and Padma Bhushan.
 
• Awardees are chosen for their "distinguished contribution in various spheres of **activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, acting, medicine, social service and public affairs."**
 
• The award was **established on January 2, 1954.**
 
• **Every year on India's Republic Day,** the Indian government bestows this honour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

**​****Karthik Chandra Rath:**

 
• He has directed more than 500 plays and written more than 100 plays.
 
• He brought ground-breaking ideas to Odia play in the areas of stagecraft, scriptwriting, and direction.
 
• He established the **Utkal Yuva Sanskrutika Sangh in Cuttack**, which participated in national theater festivals.
 
• **Kendriya Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**,** Odisha Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, and **Odisha Sahitya Akademi Award** were among the distinguished honors he received.

**Shanti Devi:**

 
• President Ram Nath Kovind presented her with the esteemed Padma Shri award on November 9, 2021.
 
• She made a significant **contribution to **the state's **Maoist-affected** districts being peaceful again.
 
• She began her social work by **establishing an ashram in** the Rayagada district of** Gobarapalli**, where she strove to support the education and well-being of tribal females.
 
• She relocated to **Gunupur**, where she **established** the **Seva Samaj Ashram in 1964** to give indigenous females access to education.
